note: Addresses are exec (RAM) addresses in Roland's 5.52 APP1 after scatter-loading. 'candidate' = located by the DM-404 project's reverse engineering (docs/HARDWARE.md), not yet checked as a Mosura hook point. Nothing here is verified: mospatch build refuses to write an image until every hook is 'verified' with expected bytes.

hooks.name: code_home
hooks.where: space for ~40 KB code + ~190 KB state
hooks.plan: Add a scatter row (or extend the startup) that copies Mosura's code to free SDRAM above the firmware's ZI regions (64 MB SDRAM at 0x80000000). Needs the RAM map from `mospatch unpack` to confirm the free range.

hooks.name: key_dispatch
hooks.plan: Branch from the key-matrix decoder's event post into mosura_on_key(id, down); call the original when it returns 0.

hooks.name: pad_events
hooks.where: ADC1 ch4/5 scan (PIT ch0, 2 kHz) -> pad on/off with velocity
hooks.plan: Find where a pad hit becomes an event; route to mosura_on_pad(pad, vel).

hooks.name: encoder_ctrl
hooks.where: VALUE reaches menus as keys 0x3f/0x40; CTRL 1-3 on ADC1 ch6 mux 1-3
hooks.plan: VALUE comes for free with key_dispatch (0x3f/0x40). CTRL values: read the firmware's filtered ADC copy each tick.

hooks.name: oled_flush
hooks.plan: Find the routine that pushes the 1 KB page buffer over LPSPI4; when Mosura is active, hand it mos_render() instead (same SSD1309 page layout).

hooks.name: pad_trigger
hooks.where: the function a pad hit calls to start a voice
hooks.plan: mos_host_note_on / note_off call it so sequenced notes play exactly like hits.

hooks.name: led_out
hooks.where: LPUART3 0x4018C000 BMC link: 01 00 idx value (page 0), pads idx 0-0x2f RGB, keys 0x30-0x52
hooks.plan: Call the firmware's BMC send routine with mos_leds() changes.

hooks.name: tick
hooks.plan: Run mos_tick from the UI task's loop (or a T-Kernel cyclic handler) using CYCCNT deltas.

hooks.name: stock_page
hooks.where: current page ID 0x80245880; FUN_800da598(n) requests a page; main page = 68
hooks.plan: mos_host_stock(1) requests page 68 and stops drawing; mos_host_stock(0) takes the screen back.

hooks.name: fx_params
hooks.where: DT1 SysEx to the BMC (F0 41 10 00 00 00 00 08 12 addr data sum F7)
hooks.plan: Not needed at first: FX keys pass through to the stock firmware.
